<style>
    .section-31 {
      --s30-border: #e3ecef;
      position: relative;
      padding: clamp(14px, 2.2vw, 27px);
      border-radius: 20px;
      border: 1px solid #e7eef0;
      background: #f8fafb;
    }

    .section-31__intro {
      margin: 0 0 15px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .section-31__intro-label {
      font-size: 10px;
      letter-spacing: .18em;
      color: #ab6907;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin: 0 0 5px;
    }

    .section-31__intro-title {
      font-size: clamp(20px, 2vw, 26px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.25;
      color: #172b35;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .section-31__radio {
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      opacity: 0;
    }

    .section-31__stage {
      border-radius: 17px;
      border: 1px solid #dfe9eb;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 30px #132d3710;
      background: #fff;
    }

    .section-31__slide {
      min-height: 185px;
      display: none;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 210px;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
      padding: clamp(19px, 2.7vw, 36px);
      background: linear-gradient(115deg, #fff 0%, #fff 64%, #e9f7f8 100%);
    }

    .section-31__slide--1 {
      display: grid;
    }

    .section-31__slide-text {
      max-width: 630px;
    }

    .section-31__slide-counter {
      color: #b17711;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: .15em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin: 0 0 7px;
    }

    .section-31__slide-title {
      font-size: clamp(23px, 2.8vw, 36px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #19303a;
      line-height: 1.12;
      margin: 0 0 9px;
    }

    .section-31__slide-desc {
      max-width: 50ch;
      font-size: clamp(13px, 1.3vw, 16px);
      line-height: 1.55;
      color: #5b6f76;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .section-31__slide-art {
      height: 150px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      position: relative;
    }

    .section-31__slide-art::before,
    .section-31__slide-art::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      border: 1px solid #5abbbd5e;
      border-radius: 50%;
      width: 142px;
      height: 142px;
    }

    .section-31__slide-art::after {
      width: 188px;
      height: 188px;
      border-color: #94ccd049;
    }

    .section-31__slide-image {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      object-fit: contain;
      width: 104px;
      height: 104px;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 10px #071c2520);
    }

    .section-31__tabs {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 12px;
    }

    .section-31__tab {
      min-width: 0;
      position: relative;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      text-align: center;
      min-height: 145px;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 15px 9px 12px;
      border: 1px solid #e1e8eb;
      border-radius: 13px;
      background: #fff;
      transition: transform .2s ease, border-color .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, background .2s ease;
    }

    .section-31__tab::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 25%;
      right: 25%;
      height: 3px;
      background: #ff9900;
      border-radius: 0 0 4px 4px;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity .2s;
    }

    .section-31__tab:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
      border-color: #abdadd;
      box-shadow: 0 9px 19px #123c4511;
    }

    .section-31__tab-icon {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      object-fit: contain;
      display: block;
    }

    .section-31__tab-title {
      font-size: clamp(11px, 1vw, 13px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #213f4b;
      line-height: 1.23;
    }

    .section-31__tab-caption {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #72848b;
      line-height: 1.33;
    }

    .section-31__hint {
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #859399;
      margin: 12px 0 0;
    }

    /* Seleção sem JavaScript; IDs dos radios mantidos */
    .section-31:has(#section-31-slide-1:checked) .section-31__slide--1,
    .section-31:has(#section-31-slide-2:checked) .section-31__slide--2,
    .section-31:has(#section-31-slide-3:checked) .section-31__slide--3,
    .section-31:has(#section-31-slide-4:checked) .section-31__slide--4,
    .section-31:has(#section-31-slide-5:checked) .section-31__slide--5 {
      display: grid;
    }

    .section-31:has(#section-31-slide-2:checked) .section-31__slide--1,
    .section-31:has(#section-31-slide-3:checked) .section-31__slide--1,
    .section-31:has(#section-31-slide-4:checked) .section-31__slide--1,
    .section-31:has(#section-31-slide-5:checked) .section-31__slide--1 {
      display: none;
    }

    .section-31:has(#section-31-slide-1:checked) .section-31__tab--1,
    .section-31:has(#section-31-slide-2:checked) .section-31__tab--2,
    .section-31:has(#section-31-slide-3:checked) .section-31__tab--3,
    .section-31:has(#section-31-slide-4:checked) .section-31__tab--4,
    .section-31:has(#section-31-slide-5:checked) .section-31__tab--5 {
      background: #edfafb;
      border-color: #47bfc7;
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #47bfc74c, 0 7px 17px #145a6018;
    }

    .section-31:has(#section-31-slide-1:checked) .section-31__tab--1::before,
    .section-31:has(#section-31-slide-2:checked) .section-31__tab--2::before,
    .section-31:has(#section-31-slide-3:checked) .section-31__tab--3::before,
    .section-31:has(#section-31-slide-4:checked) .section-31__tab--4::before,
    .section-31:has(#section-31-slide-5:checked) .section-31__tab--5::before {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .section-31 #section-31-slide-1:focus-visible~.section-31__tabs .section-31__tab--1,
    .section-31 #section-31-slide-2:focus-visible~.section-31__tabs .section-31__tab--2,
    .section-31 #section-31-slide-3:focus-visible~.section-31__tabs .section-31__tab--3,
    .section-31 #section-31-slide-4:focus-visible~.section-31__tabs .section-31__tab--4,
    .section-31 #section-31-slide-5:focus-visible~.section-31__tabs .section-31__tab--5 {
      outline: 3px solid #ff9900;
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    @media(max-width:900px) {
      .section-31__slide {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 135px;
      }

      .section-31__slide-art {
        height: 115px;
      }

      .section-31__slide-art::before {
        width: 110px;
        height: 110px;
      }

      .section-31__slide-art::after {
        width: 140px;
        height: 140px;
      }

      .section-31__slide-image {
        width: 85px;
        height: 85px;
      }

      .section-31__tabs {
        gap: 7px;
      }

      .section-31__tab {
        padding: 13px 5px;
        min-height: 135px;
      }

      .section-31__tab-caption {
        display: none;
      }
    }

    @media(max-width:650px) {
      .section-31 {
        border-radius: 16px;
        padding: 13px;
      }

      .section-31__slide {
        min-height: 162px;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 90px;
        padding: 18px;
        gap: 8px;
      }

      .section-31__slide-title {
        font-size: clamp(21px, 4.7vw, 29px);
      }

      .section-31__slide-desc {
        font-size: 12px;
      }

      .section-31__slide-art {
        height: 85px;
      }

      .section-31__slide-art::before {
        width: 75px;
        height: 75px;
      }

      .section-31__slide-art::after {
        width: 94px;
        height: 94px;
      }

      .section-31__slide-image {
        width: 56px;
        height: 56px;
      }

      .section-31__tabs {
        display: flex;
        overflow-x: auto;
        scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
        padding: 2px 1px 9px;
        scrollbar-width: thin;
        overscroll-behavior-x: contain;
      }

      .section-31__tab {
        flex: 0 0 125px;
        scroll-snap-align: start;
        min-height: 112px;
        padding: 11px 8px;
      }

      .section-31__tab-icon {
        width: 37px;
        height: 37px;
      }

      .section-31__tab-title {
        font-size: 11px;
      }
    }

    @media(max-width:410px) {
      .section-31__slide {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 64px;
        padding: 15px;
      }

      .section-31__slide-art::after {
        width: 69px;
        height: 69px;
      }

      .section-31__slide-art::before {
        width: 57px;
        height: 57px;
      }

      .section-31__slide-image {
        width: 42px;
        height: 42px;
      }
    }

    @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {
      .section-31__tab {
        transition: none;
      }
    }
  </style>
name: Section-31
